the hours on the rota. The office quotes from the rate sheet below.

turns.prompt: The house on Larkwell Road needs cover on Friday and the family have asked what the shift will cost them. What are we billing for that cover visit?
It is a senior carer for eight hours. What does an eight hour shift at the senior carer rate cost? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
